Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA.

REGISTRO: 

El registro se considera completo cuando se ha completado el registro electrónico y se ha realizado el pago (precio y métodos de pago explicados en la sección de requisitos de registro).

Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la pestaña “Horario" (Schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la pestaña “Categorías” (Events).

Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID.

*Los competidores que vengan de fuera de Lima deberán comunicarse y coordinar la forma de pago directamente con la tienda Speedcuber Perú al 991817714 o al 7505980.

El registro permanecerá abierto hasta el jueves 18 de abril o y hasta que se alcance el límite de competidores. Sin embargo, **solo tendrán derecho a recibir polo quienes completen su registro (inscripción y pago) antes del 06 de abril.**

- General classification of all events
- 3x3x3 classification for kids, 
- 3x3x3 for parents

At the main venue we have big rollup with the names of GLS record holders. It is our tradition to refresh the names after each record. During the competition we have videovlog. After the first day we organise cubers integration.

items.information:
El torneo se realizará en el Salón Principal de la Escuela Técnica de Artes Visuales Cristóbal Rojas, en Caracas, Distrito Capital.

**[URGENTE] Nos entristece profundamente saber que Venezuela ha sufrido un gran corte de energía desde el jueves por la noche, hora local. Las escuelas están cerradas por el día y se ha ordenado a los trabajadores que se queden en casa.**

**Como hay un concurso programado para este fin de semana en Caracas, nos gustaría anunciar que existe la posibilidad de que [Cubearte Caracas 2019] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubearteCaracas2019) sea cancelado. Los competidores que se hayan inscrito recibirán un correo electrónico sobre este asunto en breve.**

**Nos gustaría extender nuestras condolencias a Enrymar Cisneros (Candidato Delegado de WCA - Venezuela) y amigos en Venezuela. Se publicará una actualización sobre este asunto tan pronto como sea posible.**

***WCA Competition Announcement Team***
______

The competition will be held at Escuela Tecnica de Artes Visuales Cristobal Rojas Main Hall, on Caracas, Capital District.

**[URGENT] We are deeply saddened to learn that Venezuela has been under a major power outage since Thursday evening local time. Schools are closed for the day and workers have been ordered to stay at home.**

**As there is a competition scheduled to be held in Caracas this weekend, we would like to announce that there is a possibility [Cubearte Caracas 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubearteCaracas2019) will be cancelled. Competitors that have registered will be emailed about this matter shortly.**

**We would like to extend our condolences to Enrymar Cisneros(WCA Candidate Delegate - Venezuela) and friends in Venezuela. An update regarding this matter will be posted as soon as possible.**

***WCA Competition Announcement Team***

items.name: No Place For DNF Spring 2019
items.information:
The main event of this competition is 3x3 Fewest Moves.

-We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes before your first event because there are no set times for each group. If your first event is later in the day, you do not have to arrive until then. If you miss your group, you will be disqualified from that event.

-Groups will be posted and sent in an email a few days before the competition. When it is time to compete, groups will be called instead of individual participants.

-Food and drinks are **NOT** permitted inside the main room.  You may eat in the cafeteria next door.There are a few restaurants within a ten minute drive. 

-Live results will be posted on cubecomps.com.

-All proceeds from the competition will be donated to the No Place for Hate® club of Emmaus High School. Proceeds will not be donated to ADL directly.

-CubeDepot will sponsor the competition and will be a vendor!

**A local newspaper photographer will be taking pictures of the competition. If you would not like to have your picture taken, please let us know.**

**Please observe silence during FMC and blindfold events.**

**This competition will not be holding the famous 3x3 speedsolve event. We still encourage newer competitors to try out other events!**

El registro permanecerá abierto mientras no se alcance el límite de competidores. Sin embargo, solo tendrán derecho a recibir polo quienes completen su registro (inscripción y pago) antes del 02 de febrero.

items.information:
Дополнительная информация будет публиковаться в нашей [группе Вконтакте](https://vk.com/ksfustkamenogorskcity2019).

Перед подачей заявки ознакомьтесь с информацией о регистрации.
Регистрация с неправильно введенным именем и фамилией не будут приняты, пожалуйста внимательно проверьте внесенные данные. 
Подача заявки и оплата взноса за участие или входного билета гостя/зрителя означает, что Вы ознакомлены и согласны с правилами проведения чемпионата 
Если вы ознакомились с условиями регистрации и условиями оплаты взноса на вкладке "Как оплатить участие (Payment information)", то вы можете перейти к регистрации.

ВНИМАНИЕ!!! 
1. Если участник приходит без совершеннолетнего сопровождающего, то он обязан при себе иметь письменное заявление-согласие от родителей либо опекунов, о том, что они самостоятельно несут ответственность за несовершеннолетнего ребенка.
2. Головоломки используемые в соревнованиях должны иметь отличительные отметки, по которым их легко может идентифицировать владелец (например: нацарапанные инициалы или имя с внутренней стороны съемной крышки) 


======================================================
После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1-2 недели до соревнований вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и спам. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни).
В день соревнований участнику и гостю при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность.

For more info please visit our [VK Group](https://vk.com/ksfustkamenogorskcity2019).
Before submitting the application, read the registration information.
Registration with incorrect first and last name will not be accepted, please
carefully check the entered data.
Submitting an application and paying a participation fee or a guest / viewer entrance ticket means that you acquainted and agree with the rules of the championship
If you have read the terms of registration and the terms of payment of the fee in the tab "How to pay / How to pay for participation", then you can proceed to registration.

**ATTENTION!!!
1. If a participant under 18 years old attends the competition without adult, he must have written application from parents or legal guardians that they are responsible for their child.
2. Puzzles used in competitions must have distinctive marks by which the owner can easily identify them (for example, scratched initials or the name on the inside of the removable cover)
**

After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted.
If you did not pay the fee, then approximately 1-2 weeks before the competition you will receive an email with
a reminder to pay a fee to confirm your participation.
Be sure to check your box and spam. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be
accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but it was not confirmed within 2 business days, contact the organizers immediately (not counting the weekend).
On the day of the competition, the participant and the guest need to have an identity document.

items.information:
Mind Games 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically. 

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience or skill. There will also be event-based time limits in place, to ensure we stay on schedule, especially given the time taken by fewest moves solving. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

**The main event of this competition is Fewest Moves**

items.information:
* This is not your normal competition. If you have not competed before, you are welcome to attend, but this is not the best competition for your first experience. The competition is open to spectators at no charge.
* Please be quiet. These events can require immense focus, so as the name of the competition suggests, competitors and spectators must remain quiet to ensure fair and equal conditions for all competitors. Those who continually make noise will be asked to leave without refund.
* Competitors should expect to judge. Depending on the number of competitors who enter and the expected times per BLD attempt, the organisation team will schedule everyone's individual BLD attempts to give the competition a nice, clear structure. When you are not scheduled to compete (this includes FMCers), please be available to judge BLD attempts.

IMPORTANT! In accordance with articles 2g, 2k, and 2l, competitors that fail to abide by the specified WCA regulations shall be disqualified, at the discretion of the WCA delegate.

For further information, please send an email to [Wilson Alvis](mailto:walvisc54@gmail.com).

venue.details: Room WA224, This is the Wellesley Street east (City campus), Building A, on the second floor room 05

items.information:
New Zealand Nationals 2018 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

In Addition New Zealand Nationals 2018 will crown the National Champions in 17 events of the World Cube Associations 18 over the course of 3 days.

venue.address: 72 Kemp St, Kilbirnie, Wellington 6022, New Zealand

items.information:
Mind Games 2017 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically. 

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience or skill, but there is a competitor limit of 60 people (FMC will have a limit of 25 competitors), due to venue constraints. There will also be event-based time limits in place, to ensure we stay on schedule, especially given the time taken by fewest moves solving. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information:

Any requested changes to registration before the deadline will be honored. Your registration is not complete until your name shows up on the list. If you believe you paid and your name isn't showing up, please contact us and we will work it out.

If you have registered and are no longer able to attend, please contact us. If it is before February 3rd, you are eligible for a refund for half of your fee on the condition that there is someone on the waitlist willing to take your spot. Attempting to file a chargeback for the registration fee will lead to being blacklisted from future WCA events.

The registration fee will be $40 per competitor and there is a competitor limit of 350. Registration will open on Thursday September 7th at 8pm EST and will close on February 3rd, 2017 or when the competitor limit is reached. Competitors MUST register and pay online in order to compete.
